'''Chapter 74''' is titled "Business".

==Cover Page==
[[Buggy's Crew Adventure Chronicles]], Vol. 27: "Parade!!"

[[Buggy]], [[Alvida]], [[Mohji]] and [[Cabaji]] make short work of the [[Kumate Tribe]] as the rest of the [[Buggy Pirates|crew]] cheers them on.

==Short Summary==
[[Arlong]]'s [[fish-men]] had been beaten by [[Roronoa Zoro|Zoro]] while Arlong and his crew were in [[Cocoyasi Village]]. In order to regain the trust of the [[Arlong Pirates|pirates]] who start to think that she let the [[Swordsmen|swordsman]] escape, [[Nami]] fights with [[Usopp]] who has been captured. From Arlong's point of view, he watches her stabs him and plunge him into the sea. Satisfied by this behavior to be worthy of a true Arlong Pirate, the fish-men congratulate her. However she tells him that she only did that so that she could buy the [[Cocoyasi Village|village]] Arlong promised her. From a distance, [[Johnny]] watches unseen and quickly runs back towards the village.

Meanwhile, [[Hatchan]] returns and realizes he has been tricked by Zoro. [[Monkey D. Luffy|Luffy]] and [[Sanji]], pulled by the [[Sea Beast#Sea Cow|sea monster]] [[Momoo]], finally arrive in view of [[Arlong Park]].

==Long Summary==
Realizing it has been [[Roronoa Zoro|Zoro]] in their grasp all along, [[Arlong]] explains that since he has the highest [[bounty]] in all of [[East Blue]], it's natural that a [[Bounty Hunter|bounty hunter]] would want to take him out. He wonders where Zoro could be, to which [[Usopp]] responds that he doesn't know and asks to be let go. Though his [[Usopp's Arsenal#Lies|lie]] doesn't fool anyone, Arlong then gets the idea to kill Usopp to get Zoro to show up, but Usopp tells them that this won't work and asks [[Nami]] for help. Causing more doubt among the crew about Nami's loyalty, and Usopp berates her for betraying [[Monkey D. Luffy|Luffy]] saying that even now he still trusts her, to which Nami calls him an idiot.

[[Hatchan]] then returns, and is surprised that Arlong is back and that his [[Arlong Pirates|comrades]] are hurt, and is even more surprised to learn that it was Zoro who did it, telling the crew that he just gave him a ride to [[Cocoyasi Village]] because he was looking for Arlong and he thought Zoro was Arlong's guest. Which makes Arlong happy that Zoro is looking for him, Hatchan then asks who Usopp is. Nami, in order to prove her allegiance, attacks Usopp. She announces he will kill him and appears to stab him from Arlong's point of view. [[Johnny]] watches unseen from the bushes. Nami then pushes Usopp into the pool which solidifies the crew's trust of her, and she reminds them again of her goal - to purchase back her hometown village.

Luffy, [[Sanji]], [[Yosaku]], and Zoro all arrive at [[Arlong Park]] and are pulled ashore by [[Momoo]].

==Quick Reference==
===Chapter Notes===
*[[Kuroobi]] has always been suspicious of Nami due to her intelligence. 
**When Usopp was caught and threatened to be killed by Arlong, Nami's reactions didn't help this matter either. 
*Because of that, [[Nami]] seemingly kills [[Usopp]] in order to prove her loyalty to the [[Arlong Pirates]] and [[Johnny]] witnesses this act. 
**After killing Usopp, she pushes him into the sea. 
*[[Monkey D. Luffy|Luffy]], [[Sanji]], and [[Yosaku]] arrive.
